quality_status_policy.acceptable: Retained manifest state is historical-verified or legacy-traceable. This is a local-evidence quality label only; it is not v2 proof or rollout approval.
quality_status_policy.v2: Requires retained exact v2 proof. No input row satisfies this gate, so this status is not assigned.
quality_status_policy.unknown: The municipality has no exact slug match in the retained zone manifest; no zone provenance is inferred.
quality_status_policy.v2_proof_state: Every city is not-proven-by-retained-local-scope. The manifest marks every zone row not-assessed for v2 and the mitigation queue forbids promotion from historical linkage to v2 proof.

row_encoding: Every matrix row is positional in row_fields order. Citation tokens resolve through citation_grammar. A null source_identity_citation remains null; no source, URL, hash, or v2 proof is synthesized.

v2.assertion: No v2 proof is claimed or synthesized.
